settings.title:
India's Heritage
Non-Veg Cuisine, Reimagined
settings.subheadline: Zero Preservatives. Zero Additives. Real Ghee. Whole Spices. Authentic 200-Year-Old Recipes.

settings.story_highlight: Because 70% of India eats non-veg, yet 90% of packaged food ignores them entirely.

settings.stat_desc: A culinary truth that defines our national plates.
Leaving home-style cravers with sub-par compromises.

settings.title: 100% Real Ghee
settings.desc: We never cook in refined seed oils. Every curry is braised exclusively in pure A2 cow ghee for that authentic richness.

settings.title: Whole Spices
settings.desc: No cheap spice powders. We source organic cinnamon, green cardamom, star anise, and stone flower directly from farms.

settings.title: Zero Preservatives
settings.desc: We contain no synthetic chemicals, MSG, artificial colors, or texturised soy protein. It is honest food.

settings.title: 12-Month Shelf Life
settings.desc: Leveraging modern retort thermal processing (NASA technology), our foods stay fresh for 1 year without cold chain.

settings.title: Archival Recipe Sourcing
settings.desc: We dig deep into Awadhi, Deccani, and Mughlai culinary journals, interviewing generational royal Khansamas to capture true spice matrices.

settings.title: Braising in Ghee
settings.desc: Our meats are hand-marinated for 12 hours, then slow-cooked in large brass cauldrons in small batches over several hours.

settings.title: Hermetic Retort Sealing
settings.desc: The cooked curry is packed into multi-layer pouches and pressure-sterilised, sealing in aromas and destroying micro-organisms.

settings.title: Pantry Ready in 2 Mins
settings.desc: Simply snip the pouch, heat it in a microwave or saucepan for 120 seconds, and experience history served hot.

settings.title: The Royal Storefront
settings.description: Experience India’s finest slow-cooked meats, seasoned to perfection using original royal family archives.

settings.title: Loved by Generational Foodies
settings.description: Here is what food connoisseurs, working parents, and royal cuisine fans say about Shahi Serve.

settings.text: I was highly skeptical about packaged non-veg food. But the Rogan Josh blew my mind. The meat was tender, and that layer of ghee on top is exactly how my grandmother cooked it. This is a game changer for busy weeknights.
settings.author: Dr. Kabir Sen

settings.text: Being an expat in Bangalore, I missed Delhi's Mughlai flavors. The Galouti Kebabs taste exactly like the street stalls in Aminabad. Soft, aromatic, melts in your mouth instantly. Unbelievable that this came out of a box!
settings.author: Priyanka Verma

settings.text: No preservatives and clean labels are super important for my family. The Nalli Nihari checks every single box. It's so clean, rich, and tastes completely home-cooked. My kids love it, and I feel completely safe serving it.
settings.author: Rohan Mehra
